plan.notes: Source: official CGCC online catalog program page https://catalog.columbiagreene.edu/computer-science/associate-of-science-as/computer-science (site title: '2026-27 College Catalog'). Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's official 'Suggested Program Sequence' (1st/2nd/3rd/4th Semester), whose published semester sub-totals are 15/16/16/14 = 61, exactly matching the catalog's 'Semester Hours Required for Graduation: 61' — no discrepancy. True degree name per catalog: Computer Science, Associate of Science (A.S.), Curriculum Code 0532. Course titles, credits, and elective-slot labels copied verbatim from the sequence (e.g. 'HU ELE (3 credits)' Humanities Elective; 'MA ELE (4 credits)' Mathematics Elective; 'GN ELE' General Elective; 'SC ELE (4 credits)' Lab Science Elective; 'HU ELE or SL ELE or MA ELE or SC ELE (3 credits)' rendered as a choice slot covering all four prefixes). CS Elective note per catalog: CS-prefix courses only; CI courses not approved; AR 140/205/245/250 also allowed with advisor consultation. Verified prerequisite from the official CS 256 course page: CS 256 requires CS 134. No prerequisites were published on the fetched CS 127, CS 134 (sequence-only listing), EN 101, EN 102, MA 111, or CE 101 course pages; prereq fields were left empty rather than invented. Catalog Academic Preparation (placement, not a course prereq): 12th-grade reading level and placement readiness for EN 101 required; competency in Pre-Algebra or Pre-Statistics required by completion of 24 credits. Caveat: the college's marketing program page (www.columbiagreene.edu) lists 'CS 154 JAVA Programming' in the requirements table while the catalog's Suggested Program Sequence lists CS 127 Practical Programming — the catalog sequence was used as the authoritative term-by-term source.
